ਸਾਧ (gloss, first in ashtapadi): the Saadh, the holy one (a07.salok: the Saadhs, the holy ones)
ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ: The glory of the Saadh befits the Saadh alone
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ: the Saadh Sangat, the company of the holy
ਸਤਸੰਗੁ: the Satsang, the company of the true
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ: The Brahm Giani (gloss once: one who knows God); ਕਾ/ਕੀ/ਕੈ → The Brahm Giani's / The Brahm Giani has; ਕਉ → to the Brahm Giani; plural → Brahm Gianis
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ: The Brahm Giani's glory befits the Brahm Giani alone
ਹੁਕਮੇ / ਹੁਕਮਿ: By his Hukam (gloss once: God's command) / in his Hukam
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਗੁ / ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸ: Whatever pleases God / him, that in the end comes to pass
ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ: does and causes all to be done
ਤੈਸਾ ... ਤੈਸਾ: X is the same as Y (To him X is the same as Y)
ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ... ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ: that God is himself all in all
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ: Dharam Rai, the judge of souls (gloss once per ashtapadi)
ਨਾਮੁ / ਨਾਮ: the Naam (gloss once per ashtapadi: the Naam, God's Name)
ਸਿਮਰਨ / ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ: Simran (gloss once: the remembrance) / remember him in Simran again and again
ਬਿਸਨ: Vishnu, the all-pervading Lord (a09.p2); the all-pervading Lord (a09.p3)
ਨਾਨਕ (vocative / signature): O Nanak (vocative); Nanak (where Nanak is the subject)
ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥ / ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥: Salok. / Ashtapadi. (kept as in our Hindi)
ਅਪਰਸ: the Apras, the one untouched by evil
ਬੈਸਨੋ: a Vaishnav, a devotee of Vishnu
ਭਗਉਤੀ: a Bhagauti, a worshipper of the Lord
